style.styleTitle: Everlands 60cm Snowy Pinecone and Berry Christmas Wreath
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Welcome the winter season in style with this stunning 60cm Everlands Snowy Berry Christmas Wreath. Boasting a lush, realistic appearance thanks to its shape-retaining PE needles, this full green wreath instantly creates a wintry atmosphere on any wall, door, or table. </p><p>It is beautifully detailed with natural pine cones, a rustic vine base, and a light, snowy finish for incredible depth and texture. </p><p>Delivered unlit, it serves as the perfect canvas for you to add your own string lights or simply enjoy its natural elegance.</p><p><strong>Key Features:</strong></p><ul><li>Dimensions: 60cm (Diameter) x approx. 11cm (Height)<br></li><li>Material: Highly realistic, shape-retaining PE needles<br></li><li>Design: Authentic vine base decorated with natural pine cones<br></li><li>Finish: Light snowy flocking for a fresh, wintry appearance<br></li><li>Use: Unlit indoor wreath, ready to hang or decorate to your own taste</li></ul>
